items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Outplayed by Henderson in Week 2
items.description:
Stevenson rushed six times for 43 yards while catching one of two targets for three yards in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Steelers. He also lost a fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Fails to throw TD in Week 2 win
items.description:
Maye completed 14 of 22 passes for 208 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Steelers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Scores 39-yard TD in season debut
items.description:
Henderson (ankle) rushed 16 times for 76 yards and a touchdown and wasn't targeted in the passing game during Sunday's 20-3 win over the Steelers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Travis Etienne: Limited volume in Baltimore
items.description:
Etienne carried the ball eight times for 25 yards and caught both his targets for six yards in Sunday's 24-17 win over the Ravens. He added a two-point conversion.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Produces two TDs in Week 2 win
items.description:
Shough completed 27 of 34 passes for 252 yards and a touchdown while adding 23 yards and a TD on nine carries in Sunday's 24-17 win over the Ravens.
